candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 2m
verified_facts: The product is a 2m bare-earth raster elevation model covering about 99% of England.
Surface objects are removed using bespoke algorithms and manual editing to produce the terrain surface.
Where repeat surveys exist the newest best-resolution data is used and resampling uses bilinear interpolation.
The dataset declares EPSG:27700 and +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy and exposes WCS access.
semantic_limits: The 2m product is a secondary scale/lineage check and must not silently replace the SHA-bound 1m primary parcel result.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 product and official overview accuracy
verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 is a low-resolution terrain model published with 50m post spacing for broad-area applications.
The official OS overview reports the grid data was verified to 4m RMSE.
The current product page describes it as suitable for broad applications over large areas and updated annually.
semantic_limits: OS Terrain 50 remains a coarse secondary cross-check and cannot be used as a parcel-scale accuracy upgrade over EA LiDAR DTM 1m.
